There was a big red carpet, and above it were slices of long red cloth strings attached to the sides of that area. In the middle, all those strings were attached to a red circular thing hanging above.

So I came in and started roaming around, trying to find someone to talk to. By the way, there was no roof in the middle of that haveli. So I found a guy, and we talked. I do not remember about what.

Then we went to this aunty who was wearing a saree with red and yellow colors in it, and we asked her where the girl was. She pointed toward one of the upper rooms. So we both started going there, and in between we saw this very beautiful aunty whose saree color was purple and white. She had curly hair and a curvy body, and she went into a room.

My lustful brain, for some reason, started peeking through a hole that was in one of the bricks. Then she went into a squatting position and just started staring at me. So we started marching toward the room after going through the staircase to the first floor. Outside that room, I saw a guy giving money to a girl and, I think, her husband. The girl was wearing a pink saree, and she had covered her face.

Now the scene changes, and I am sitting on a sofa, and there is a table. An uncle and aunty were there, whom I do not know, and there was tea in cups on the brown circular table. posts.title: The School Bus Dream

And suddenly, I was in the bus with another girl, and everyone disappeared except the guy who was driving. Then he left the girl at her destination, and then he reversed the bus. While reversing, he tried to go forward into the grass area, and then he stopped it on the slope.

So I asked him, “What the fuck are you doing?” He said he was turning it and we were going back to school. So I looked behind, and I remembered that my house was pretty close to that main road. So I told him, “Just get me to the main road and I’ll go by myself.” He said no, so I was just sitting there.

Then suddenly he decided not to reverse anymore and to go straight on the path. He increased the speed, and he was just going on the right side. I looked and saw a lot of balls made of sand, but I did not care. But there was a line, a wall of sand.

Then we got to this area where there was a pit of sand, and beside it, at a lower level, there was a whole sandy area. So the bus driver decided to go full speed and jump the bus to that lower area. So he did. Then there were some more sandy, rough, bumpy areas with patches of different tires on them.

Now suddenly the scene changes, and I am one of the construction workers that were working in that sand bed. I saw the bus going away from my direction, so I notified others, and everyone just started running and started trying to stop him, but he did not listen.

Then we got a camera, and then I became the two construction workers who were running from that area. While they were running, a dinosaur came, which only had a skeleton on it, and he ate the guy who was on top of me. And then as soon as he started to leave, I started running, and he recognized me running and also ate me.

Then the scene changes again, and now I am in a costume, and I am asking my friend to open the door. The costume seems very sci-fi. So he opens the door, and from the sandy area we go into some abandoned building.

There, while being in the mask, I ask to stand for that dinosaur and the others, and the scan gets completed. It turns out he was at the edge of the side, so I took out my sniper and came in front of him and shot him, and then ran back. The sound of the sniper was the same as the sound of that sniper from Apex Legends Mobile (Kraber).

Then he came in front of me in that hall, so I again sniped him and then again knifed him. But it turns out that the dinosaur was just getting its energy. I was targeting the eye, and whenever I hit the eye, a blue line came at the side of the eyes, and it seemed like it was absorbing that energy before shooting.

Then, after those two bullets, the AI that was in my suit converted the whole area into some school. And the dinosaur had a skin on it; it did not have any of that stuff in real life in the dream, but the system created this whole projection for me so it would be easy for me to kill that fucker.
And then while I shot those two bullets, some people in my real life woke me up, and the dream ended.

posts.title: The Brown Book and the Robots
posts.body:
In this dream, I was in a room, and the atmosphere of the room was yellowish-brown. Suddenly, a book came into my hand. It was brown in color, and something was written on it in golden color.

When I opened the book, the pages were brown in color, and I could also smell the fragrance of the pages that usually comes from an old book. Then I opened a part of the book and saw a picture of a brown robot. Then I went to another page, and there was another robot. Then I saw another robot, and then another robot, but this robot had a chainsaw with it.

Then suddenly the scene changed, and I was in a plain field. There was sunlight, and there was a surface full of grass. I started running for some reason, and then I was just running as fast as I could. When I looked behind, the first robot was just running behind me, so my heartbeat in real life started to increase and I ran even faster.
Then these robots started to come from all sides while I was running, and eventually I got caught, and there was black.

Then the scene was again the same. There was sunlight and green grass, but this time I was behind a bush. It was a square area with fences, and I was hiding from something. When I peeped from the bush, I saw that second robot, and it started, and then it to swami, but I was hiding from him.

Then I started running, but I got stuck in the fence, and then he killed me, I think, because then it was black, and then I woke up. My heartbeat was racing very high, and I could hear staff from someone. It was a male. Then suddenly there was complete silence.

Then I went back to sleep, and this time there were dark clouds, and there was just a flat brown area. I was running as fast as I could, and they all were coming from the front and from behind. It was a very tense chaos.

I also got the ability to jump very high, so I was running and jumping, dodging every single one of them. It was the chainsaw one this time, and I was just running, running, running, dodging every single one of them.

But then suddenly I saw a city with big buildings, and I was very happy, so I ran, ran, ran. Suddenly, the four chainsaw people robots started coming towards me with a wide alien-like face with eyes and two hands, and it was in a rocky shape like that rock Pokemon.

I was going to dodge him, but he was in the air, and it was hard to dodge him. But somehow I dodged him from under. Because I dodged him from under, I had no time to jump, and I got got by four robots. Then there was black, and I woke up.

When I woke up, my heartbeat was racing very high, and I was sweaty.

#weird

Then the guy came and asked me what I wanted. I said I wanted a loan because, for some reason, I could not get my money out. Then the guy asked what it was for, and I told him I wanted to find someone, and I showed him the photo of that kid.

The guy said these types of cases are common and that the kid would not be found. Then we had a little more discussion, and after that I woke up.

Then I slept again in real life, and this time I was in a jungle. An animal like a tiger was having a race with me, and it was epic. My legs were flying like a bird. But in the middle of the race, a guy came and said, “Go back home.” So the animal and I started going back, and the area around us slowly started to have buildings.

Then I woke up. Not gonna lie, I was very happy while racing.

I slept again, and this time I was in a house. I was sitting beside a girl whose face I do not remember, and in front of us was a small round brown table. We were sitting on the floor. The floor was made of marble, and the house looked expensive.

We were playing some game — I do not remember what — but I was losing continuously. Every time I lost, I kissed both of her cheeks, the bone area between the neck and face on the right side, and the palm of her hand.

So I started walking towards the girls, but then I changed my path and started walking straight.
